thread:
lina: Heads-up: CloudBox integration goes live next week. We need a minimal SEV process for marketplace + infra partner issues. Can we agree on a compact protocol we can pin?

raj: +1. My 2¢: triage in the partnership channel, if SEV1 -> create war-room and page SRE immediately. SEV2 -> triage in-channel and decide whether to escalate.

diane: Add a pre-escalation check: creds/certs first. ~30% of partner failures are token/cert problems. If creds fail, tag partner ops and skip pagers for now.

pete_sre: Ops details: PagerDuty config: SEV1 pages full escalation, SEV2 pages primary only. We'll use an ephemeral bridge for SEV1 (Zoom/bridge) and keep notes in the channel. I'll pin the bridge template.

lina: Good. Minimal incident one-liner we should use in channel (so bots/partners see consistent data):
```
Partner: <name> | Sev: SEV# | Impact: <short> | Ticket: <url> | Logs: <link> | Owner: @user
```

raj: That works. Example: `Partner: CloudBox | Sev: SEV2 | Impact: manifest uploads failing | Ticket: https://zendesk/... | Owner: @diane`

partner_ops_bot: automated: New integration alert: IN-4503 (CloudBox) — manifest upload failures. Severity: SEV2. Reported by diane. Ticket: https://zendesk.example/IN-4503

diane: I'll take first look. Checklist I'll run before paging: (1) certs/tokens, (2) manifest payload size, (3) marketplace schema mismatch, (4) last successful upload id.

pete_sre: Acked. Pin-ready bridge command (example):
```
/bridge start --title "Partner IN-4503 CloudBox" --zoom quicklink --notify oncall-sre,partnerships,eng-runtime
```

lina: SLA ack targets proposal: SEV1 = 10m, SEV2 = 30m. If not acked escalate to partnerships lead and SRE manager. Thoughts?

raj: +1. Also add automated ack from partner_ops_bot when ticket created. Bot should post ack timestamp.

partner_ops_bot: automated: Acknowledgement recorded for IN-4503 by @diane at 1799990045.

pete_sre: For Dedicated/private partner infra: include infra-owner in the initial notify list. Tag with `#dedicated` and include deploy id `cust_deploy=<id>` in the one-liner.

diane: Postmortem split: partnerships handles external comms + SLA impacts; ops/eng owns RCA and mitigation steps. Postmortems must list deploy hashes, marketplace deploy id, and partner correlation id.

lina: Action items: raj -> channel topic template + rotation calendar; pete -> pin bridge/PD play; diane -> credential checklist & quick runbook. Due EOD tomorrow.

raj: I'll create the calendar and update the topic to: `Oncall: @person | War-room: /bridge start | Rotation: <link>`

partner_ops_bot: automated: Reminder: fill channel topic with oncall contact or bot will send daily nudges.

diane: Let's run a tabletop drill next Thu 11:00 to validate ack -> war-room -> mitigation flow.

pete_sre: I'll run the drill and record timings. We'll measure time-to-ack and time-to-war-room.

lina: Final note: keep war-rooms short. Always assign a PM/postmortem owner before closing the incident. Post a 1-line summary in the channel when closing. :shipit:

raj: On it. If anyone wants to test the flow sooner ping me and I'll start a fake IN ticket.

partner_ops_bot: automated: Thread will be archived after 90 days of inactivity.
